title: RunOptions
description: Per-run parameter overlay supplied by the caller in `POST /runs`; runs.md §Run options states its semantics. `configurable` is `configurable.schema.json`, closed, nested and versioned: an unknown root key, an unknown key inside a section, or a dotted key MUST be rejected with `400 validation_error` (runs.md §Run options, "Validation and persistence"). RFC 0094 §A: this schema is an `allOf` branch of the composed `createRun` request body in `api/v2/openapi.yaml`, so it is OPEN at its own root and carries no `additionalProperties` keyword at all. `false` would reject the body's own `workflowId`; `true` would mark every property evaluated and so switch the composed closure off. The closure (`unevaluatedProperties: false`) lives at that composition site, the only place JSON Schema 2020-12 can express closure over an `allOf`. Validated on its own, this schema accepts unknown root keys; validate the composed request body.

tags.description: Free-form caller tags for filtering/correlation. A host MUST NOT reject a tag on format and MUST answer 400 validation_error over maxItems=100 or per-tag maxLength=256 (runs.md §Run options).

metadata.description: Free-form caller metadata. Persisted on the run doc; surfaces back via `RunSnapshot.metadata`. Server MAY enforce a serialized-size limit (recommended: 50KB).

Configurable.description: Not the wire shape: no schema references this flat key set, and `RunOptions.configurable` is `configurable.schema.json` (closed, nested in sections; an unknown or dotted key MUST be rejected with `400 validation_error`, runs.md §Run options, "Validation and persistence"). It is kept only as the home of `$defs/MockProvider`, the informative mock-provider catalog.

recursionLimit.description: Override the per-run node-execution ceiling. Server clamps to `Capabilities.limits.maxNodeExecutions`.

model.description: Override the AI model for nodes that consume `ctx.config.configurable.model`. Examples: `gpt-4`, `claude-opus-4-7`, `gemini-2.5-pro`.

temperature.description: Override AI temperature. Server SHOULD enforce 0..2 range.

promptOverrides.description: Per-prompt-ID variant override. Map of canonical prompt ID -> override text.

MockProvider.description: Routes AI activity calls through a deterministic mock provider instead of real LLM APIs. Test-keys-only — server returns 403 mock_provider_forbidden on production keys (runs.md §`ai` section).

id.description: Selects a mock provider from the server's catalog (advertised via `Capabilities.testing.mockProviders`). The spec-canonical baseline `stream-text` MUST be supported for OpenWOP v1.0 conformance; other providers (`tool-calls`, `error`, `usage-only`) are recommended but not required.
